```yaml
name: Update ingestr

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'   # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Check for new ingestr release
        id: check
        run: |
          # Get latest release tag from ingestr repo
          LATEST_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/ingestr/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          echo "latest=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Get current version from go.mod
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -E '^github.com/ingestr/ingestr' go.mod | awk '{print $2}')
          echo "current=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Compare
          if [ "$LATEST_TAG" != "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "update_needed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "update_needed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create branch and bump ingestr
        if: steps.check.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        env:
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ steps.check.outputs.latest }}
        run: |
          BRANCH="update-ingestr-${NEW_VERSION}"
          echo "BRANCH=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"

          # Update go.mod with the new version
          sed -i "s|github.com/ingestr/ingestr.*|github.com/ingestr/ingestr $NEW_VERSION|g" go.mod
          git add go.mod
          git commit -m "Bump ingestr to $NEW_VERSION"
          git push -u origin "$BRANCH"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const head = process.env.BRANCH;
            const base = 'main';
            const title = `Bump ingestr to ${process.env.NEW_VERSION}`;
            const body = 'Automated update of ingestr dependency.';
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.create({
              owner,
              repo,
              title,
              head,
              base,
              body
            });
            console.log(`Created PR #${pr.number}`);
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          BRANCH: ${{ env.BRANCH }}
          NEW_VERSION: ${{ steps.check.outputs.latest }}
```
